name: get_at_risk_deals
when: Produce a report of at-risk deals from the CRM, including owner and reason.
steps: Call crm.list_deals({}) to retrieve all deals, iterating with 'cursor' until all pages are collected.
Filter the collected deals to identify 'OPEN' deals by checking their 'stage' (e.g., 'qualified', 'negotiation', 'proposal').
From the 'OPEN' deals, identify 'at-risk' deals by checking their 'health' status ('R' or 'A').
For each at-risk deal, call crm.get_owner to retrieve owner details.
If the owner's 'active' status is false, report the owner as 'UNASSIGNED'; otherwise, use the owner's 'name'.
